$comment: Known advisories CI accepts in what runs in production. Each needs a reason it can't reach us, a date it was reviewed, and an expiry after which CI fails until someone looks again. See docs/SUPPLY-CHAIN.md. The fourth known moderate one (GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq, uuid under jayson) is fixed by the overrides entry in package.json, not allowed here.

advisories.reason: Only jayson's server/stream helpers (lib/utils.js) load stream-json; @solana/web3.js uses jayson/lib/client/browser, which never requires it. The fixed stream-json (3.6+) is ESM-only and can't be required by jayson, so there is no safe override.
Same as GHSA-528h-pc64-c93x: the JSONC parser and verifier are never loaded by the RPC client we use.
Same as GHSA-528h-pc64-c93x: the Assembler is never loaded by the RPC client we use.
